snippet.title: NINJA WARRIOR VR | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
▼ The thrill and excitement of “Ninja Warrior” come alive in VR! ▼
Use every bit of your strength, balance, and reflexes to conquer intense obstacle courses through full-body motion.

◆ Release Information
Release Date : December 18, 2025
Store : Meta Horizon Store
https://www.meta.com/experiences/25231809936413826/

🔥What is Ninja Warrior VR?🔥
Ever since its 1997 television debut in Japan, Ninja Warrior has captivated viewers around the world with its thrilling and competitive entertainment. Now, that thrill and competition are coming to VR. 
Experience the rush of stepping onto the Ninja Warrior stage as if you were a real competitor and challenge your limits, all from the comfort of your home. Or enjoy the course with friends and cheer each other on!

#NINJYAWARRIOR #NINJYAWARRIORVR  #SASUKE #SASUKEVR
